messages:
maria: small onboarding snag: sample apps surface different error formats depending on SDK. mobile sees plain 401, web sees a nested object, server SDK raises a typed exception. makes centralized retry & telemetry messy. any appetite for a minimal contract the runtime emits and SDKs wrap?

kevin: yes. we've had to special-case each SDK in the mobile telemetry layer. small canonical payload + language-native exceptions would save a lot.

tara: proposal: runtime returns compact JSON with fields: type, status, message, error_class, retryable, retry_after_seconds (optional), hint_code (optional), doc_url (optional). SDKs map to exceptions but attach the raw payload as `raw_error`.

nils: agree. suggest `error_class` enums: auth, permission, rate_limit, user_input, not_found, conflict, transient. apps can switch on that.

maria: UX note: we must separate user-facing copy from developer logs. UI strings should be curated (i18n) and short: e.g., "Session expired  please sign in." Dev log can include more context: "AuthError: refresh token invalid (401)".

kevin: streaming corner case: mid-stream failures should include same canonical body + optional `resume_token`/`stream_offset`. SDKs surface StreamInterruptedError with resume data.

ci-bot: test suggestion: add a small CI matrix that has runtime emit each canonical body and asserts SDKs expose `error_class`, `retryable`, and `raw_error`. run nightly and gate client releases.

tara: mapping sketch for runtime: 400->user_input(false); 401/403->auth/permission(false); 404->not_found(false); 409->conflict(false); 429->rate_limit(true, use Retry-After); 5xx->transient(true). populate retry_after_seconds from Retry-After when present.

nils: tiny ergonomics: SDK exceptions should be idiomatic (e.g., RateLimitError in py/js, error types in go) but all should expose `status` and `is_retryable`. also include `hint_code` values such as `refresh_token`, `backoff`, `reduce_concurrency`.

maria: sample snippet for docs (dev-facing):

```json
{
  "type": "RateLimitError",
  "status": 429,
  "message": "Too many requests",
  "error_class": "rate_limit",
  "retryable": true,
  "retry_after_seconds": 30,
  "hint_code": "reduce_concurrency",
  "doc_url": "https://docs.redwood.ai/errors#rate-limit"
}
```

kevin: agree on doc_url. helps product SDKs point users to actionable guidance in the UI.

tara: next steps: i'll sketch an RFC with minimal server patch and examples for py/go/js. volunteers to coauthor SDK patches and runtime tests?

maria: i can coauthor the RFC and handle py sdk changes.

kevin: i'll take go and mobile SDK patches.

nils: i'll add runtime tests and a CI job for the error matrix.

maria: i'll open tracking ticket DX-ERR-3107 and link the RFC. thanks folks :sparkles

jira-bot: Created ticket DX-ERR-3107: "Runtime canonical error body + SDK wrapping" assigned to maria, kevin, nils.
